MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.025
   D. 0.205

2. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 20
   C. 21
   D. 1

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 48

4. Solve for x: x + 7 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 9
   C. 16
   D. 7

5. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 50
   C. 7
   D. 49

6. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 40

7. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 16
   C. 65
   D. 0

8. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 37
   C. 5
   D. 36

9. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 26

10. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 36

11. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

12. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 5
   C. 11
   D. 25

13. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

14. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 82
   D. 9

15. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 11
   D. 121

16. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 29
   C. 3
   D. 28

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
